def test_triples_sum_to_zero():
    # Triple exists: 1 + 2 + (-3) = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, -3]) == True

    # Triple exists: 1 + (-1) + 0 = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, -1, 0]) == True

    # Triple exists: 2 + 2 + (-4) = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([2, 2, -4]) == True

    # Triple exists with multiple candidates
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, 3, -6]) == True

    # No triple sums to zero
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, 3]) == False

    # All positive numbers
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([5, 10, 15, 20]) == False

    # All negative numbers
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([-1, -2, -3]) == False

    # Empty list
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([]) == False

    # Fewer than 3 elements
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, -1]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([0]) == False

    # Exactly 3 elements that don't sum to zero
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, 4]) == False

    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 1, 1]) == False

# Run tests

def test_triples_sum_to_zero():
    # Triples that sum to zero exist
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 3, -2, 1]) == True
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([2, 4, -5, 3, 9, 7]) == True
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([-1, 0, 1]) == True
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([5, -1, -4, 2]) == True

    # Duplicates at distinct positions still count
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([0, 0, 0]) == True
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 1, -2]) == True

    # No triple sums to zero
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 3, 5, 0]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, 3, 7]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, 3]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([-1, -2, -3]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, -1]) == False

    # Fewer than three elements
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([0, 0]) == False
